newsitem.title: USA: Pool Energy to buy R&H Well Service.
newsitem.headline: Pool Energy to buy R&H Well Service.

text.p: Pool Energy Services Co said Monday it signed a letter of intent to buy R&H Well Service Inc of Midland, Texas, for an undisclosed price.

Chief executive Jim Jongebloed said he expected the acquisition to add about $34 million in annual revenues, based on current market conditions. The company said it expects to close the deal before October.

The company said R&H has a fleet of about 67 land well-servicing rigs, 104 fluid hauling and other trucks, 430 frac and other tanks, and five brine and disposal wells in the Permian Basin of West Texas.

The R&H acquisition of R&H is Pool Energy's second in the Permian Basin. The company June 25 completed its purchase of DA&S Oil Well Servicing Inc with a fleet of 37 rigs, which it said would add $12 million in annual revenues.

Pool Energy posted net earnings of $3.8 million on revenues of $99.4 million in the first quarter, compared with a $1.4 million net on revenues of $82.3 million the year before. Its stock hit a new 52-week high on Monday of 20-3/4 and traded at 19-15/16 in the late afternoon, up 5/16.
A spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate on the deals.
